proof_scope: Exact rational arithmetic lifts input IEEE754 coordinates exactly; no clipping epsilon or random/grid sampling.

Every expected primitive is exactly convex. Its union is decomposed into non-overlapping convex cells. Signed actual-mesh tetrahedra are integrated against every convex cell to derive full ordinary-solid intersections after exact embedding validation.

All actual triangle-pair intersections are checked exactly after conservative AABB exclusion, as well as edge, vertex-link, connectedness and orientation. Binary STL triangle coordinates equal audited JSON coordinates.

The expected external boundary is derived per primitive finite face, subtracting every other primitive and resolving coplanar duplicate ownership. Exterior patch integral equals the separately computed union volume exactly.

The envelope is a UNION of EACH finite convex surface patch plus a +/-5e-6mm cube, never a hull of the entire nonconvex object. All source surface patches, including concavities and holes, are fully subtracted against this union in both directions.
Exact coincident finite patches are removed first for role and location analysis. Original input skin front is distinguished from added backing, extrusion sides and artificial supports.
limits: A0/A1/B ordinary-solid differences are nonzero and must never be called exact occupied-domain equality. Only south band is exactly equal.
The Hausdorff bound concerns the entire pair of boundaries. It is not a physical printing, material strength, source architecture, global minimum-wall or minimum-neck certificate.
Maximum assigned support-plane distances are approximate descriptive statistics; the independently exact all-point envelope bound is the rigorous distance guarantee.
Bboxes are conservative common enclosures for both difference domains, not exact minimal separate extra/missing cell bboxes. No per-role solid-volume allocation is claimed.
Source/hypothesis role means the supplied expected manufacturing input front, not a newly validated original real-building surface. Raw source audit remains the source reviewer responsibility.
retained_failure_history: Original v6 self-overlaps and directed-volume-only reports remain one directory above. Earlier single-axis projection coverage failures are retained in BOUNDARY-ENVELOPE-ALL.json; the finite Minkowski proof succeeds without relaxing the 1e-5mm Euclidean target.
